user.title: Add an Időkép location
user.description: Type the name of a Hungarian place as it is written on idokep.hu, for example Érd or Balatonfüred.

data_description.location: Settlement name. Accents are optional: "erd" works for Érd.

reconfigure.title: Change the location
reconfigure.description: Entity IDs stay the same, so dashboards and automations keep working.

data_description.location: Settlement name, as written on idokep.hu.

init.title: Időkép options
init.description: The 30-day forecast needs one more download from idokep.hu per update. Station sensors read the selected point from the Időkép maps. Smog sensors are offered only when the location has a matching station on the smog map.

data_description.measurement_point: Use the station name or its Időkép identifier. The point may not provide every measurement.

error.measurement_point_required: Enter a measurement point name or ID to enable station sensors.
